title: Group Chat Dare
scenario: Someone in a class chat dares you to send an embarrassing photo to prove you are brave.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.C: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Group Chat Dare: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: A real friend will not pressure you to share private images.
